mentions.name: Mobile RPG Engine & Toolset
mentions.description: This project is an RPG engine and toolset in the style of SNES/Game Boy era RPGs like Final Fantasy. It targets iOS and Android, and the editor tools themselves can be shipped inside the mobile client or run on the web for more screen real estate.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m making an RPG Engine/toolset (i.e. Final Fantasy SNES or Game boy) that targets iOS/Android and the tools themselves are shippable in the mobile client (or web if you want some actual screen real estate)
